snapshot.title: Integrate weather/day-night system into Earth scenes
snapshot.description: Wire the new environment system into Earth scenes that use Earth backdrops (earth_base_1 and related Earth1 backdrop scenes), including at least one weather event such as cloud drift.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Earth base scene uses the new engine and visual effects
Mission debrief and orbit preview scenes also receive compatible day/night visuals
At least one weather event (e.g., clouds) is enabled and visible
